pages.title: From invite to your first text
pages.subtitle: Five steps to your first real conversation. The whole setup takes about 20 minutes.

blocks.note: That part takes weeks. Everything below is your own setup.

blocks.heading: Steps 1 to 3: log in, add contacts, send

paragraphs.text: Open the invitation email from Salesmessage, click the link and set your password. Done when you're logged in and can see your company's workspace and your inbox.
Add one contact by hand, or import your list. You can't text anyone until someone's in here, and people often skip this step. Done when someone you plan to text is in.
Pick a contact, write something real rather than a test, and send. Done when your message shows as delivered.

blocks.title: Working in HubSpot? Contacts arrive gradually
blocks.text: They come across as they're used: searched for, opened in the Salesmessage panel, or run through a workflow. Ask your admin if you need your list brought over in bulk.

blocks.heading: Before you send: opt-in and credits
blocks.intro: A phone number in your CRM isn't permission to text. Only message people who agreed to hear from you. Each text costs credits.

cards.label: One emoji or curly quote
cards.caption: per credit, so the cost doubles
cards.note: Watch for quotes pasted from Word

pages.title: Prove it works both ways
pages.subtitle: Get a reply, set up wherever you work, and know who to ask when stuck.

blocks.heading: Steps 4 and 5: reply, then work anywhere

paragraphs.text: Ask a colleague to text your Salesmessage number, then reply from your inbox. This proves messages reach you as well as leave you. Done when you've received an inbound, got a notification and replied.
Install the mobile app so you're reachable away from your desk, and the Chrome extension if you text from your browser. Done when you see the same conversations everywhere.

blocks.title: Working in HubSpot? Two things only you can do
blocks.text: Add the Salesmessage App Card in your HubSpot settings; it won't appear on contact records until you do. And check your HubSpot user is mapped to your Salesmessage user: unmapped users can't send.

items.question: My message didn't deliver.
items.answer: Usually it's the number or the message content. Send your admin the contact and the time; they can see the delivery status.

items.question: No notification for an inbound message?
items.answer: Check your notification settings first, then your phone's. Still nothing? Tell your admin which inbox.

items.question: No App Card in HubSpot?
items.answer: You have to add it yourself in HubSpot settings (step 5). If it's there but won't send, you're not mapped yet.

blocks.title: Stuck? Ask your account admin first
blocks.text: Most of this they can fix in a minute, including mapping your HubSpot user. For anything else, the Help Center is at help.salesmessage.com, or email us.
